symbols.name: triples
symbols.meaning: The set of all three-element subsets of the ground set.
symbols.quote: A *triple* is a three-element subset of $[h]$, and $\mathcal K$ is the set of all triples.

symbols.name: bank X
symbols.meaning: One of the two banks of scalars, indexed by triples of triples.
symbols.quote: The network has two banks, $X$ and $Y$, with entries $x_\beta$ and $y_\beta$.

symbols.name: bank Y
symbols.meaning: The second of the two banks of scalars, indexed by triples of triples.
symbols.quote: The network has two banks, $X$ and $Y$, with entries $x_\beta$ and $y_\beta$.

symbols.name: bank index
symbols.meaning: A triple of triples that indexes one entry of a bank.
symbols.quote: A *bank* is a family of scalars indexed by $\beta=(\beta_1,\beta_2,\beta_3)\in\mathcal K^3$.

symbols.name: source vector
symbols.meaning: The vector of source-bank entries on one line, indexed by triples.
symbols.quote: Call these two vectors $\xi$ (the source) and $\eta$ (the target), so that $\xi_T$ is the source entry at triple $T$ and $\eta_S$ is the target entry at triple $S$.

symbols.name: target vector
symbols.meaning: The vector of target-bank entries on one line, indexed by triples.
symbols.quote: Call these two vectors $\xi$ (the source) and $\eta$ (the target), so that $\xi_T$ is the source entry at triple $T$ and $\eta_S$ is the target entry at triple $S$.

symbols.name: binary field
symbols.meaning: The field with two elements, whose arithmetic is mod 2.
symbols.quote: All arithmetic is mod 2: the scalars lie in the binary field $\mathbb F_2=\{0,1\}$, where $-1=1$, so signs vanish.

symbols.name: side wire
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary wire attached to an ordered neighbouring pair of triples.
symbols.quote: For each ordered neighbouring pair $(S,T)$ there is a side wire $W_{ST}$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary wire attached to one element of the ground set.
symbols.quote: For each element $\ell\in[h]$ there is a central wire $C_\ell$.

symbols.name: ground element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set, indexing a central wire.
symbols.quote: For each element $\ell\in[h]$ there is a central wire $C_\ell$.

symbols.name: identity matrix
symbols.meaning: The h by h identity matrix.
symbols.quote: For the bit network take $\mathbb Q^h$ with the form $\langle x,y\rangle=x^{\mathsf T}(I-J/9)y$, where $I$ is the $h\times h$ identity matrix and $J$ is the all-one matrix.

relations.quote: Each gate and terminal is labelled by [Subspace labels](subspace-labels.md): a nondegenerate subspace of a fixed bilinear space.

relations.predicate: is built within the framework of
relations.quote: The network is built within the framework of [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md): every wire is a role and every gate carries a frame, so the same scalar gates can act on arrays.
Orthogonality and nondegeneracy are tested with the form of [Bilinear form](bilinear-form.md).
